newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Metal Mining to scale back gold dealing.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Metal Mining to scale back gold dealing.

text.p: Sumitomo Metal Mining Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it will scale back its gold dealing operations, particularly in the Tokyo bullion market, due to sluggish trade.
"Gold trading in the local Tokyo market has been sluggish in the past few years, making it hard for us to generate profits from the business," a company official said.
Sumitomo Metal Mining said sales from its gold dealing operations are likely to fall to about 50 billion yen in fiscal 1997/98, which began on April 1, from about 170 billion yen in 1996/97.
The company also said total sales in 1997/98 are expected to slip to 320 billion yen from 421.9 billion yen in 1996/97, due partly to the expected impact from the scaling back of its gold dealing.
It said the impact on current profits is likely to be slight, however, due to slim profit margins in gold dealing.
